title: Highway field inspections, crew dispatch, source reconciliation and complete receiving

task.name: Commission the complete selected Highway field and reconciliation workflow
task.purpose: Give field staff, supervisors and the implementation team one usable local application for actual source assets, typed inspections, original attachments, crew assignments, effort, follow-through and approved candidate edits. Carry the complete source editions, every business decision and the original paired comparison into an independently editable receiving workspace. Give a named field colleague a complete source-bound editable copy, retain their complete returned editions and unfinished draft, reconcile those observations against current supervisor work and carry all original files through independent receiving.
task.request: Continue the original customer Workshare and Installation. Select the actual ArcGIS service and advertised datasets, complete capture population, source identities and metadata, actual field forms, staffing and operating packages. Retain all original feature/attachment bytes; operate inspection save, submit, correction and supervisor review; connect those decisions to assignment progress and actual effort. Receive a later complete source capture, resolve field conflicts and rebase the original inspection and assignment. Produce reviewed local proposals and reconcile captured versus proposed datasets through the included original SF30/SF100 producer and DuckDB paired engine. Export both the complete staff workspace and native comparison package, independently receive them and continue actual later work. Record the observed customer receiving result in the original SCF Installation. Use Field copies & returns for actual selected inspections: issue complete original JSON and editable HTML with named recipient/instructions, operate the independent field editor, retain all named editions/unfinished work and attachment bytes, compare issued/current/returned values and explicitly adopt per-inspection decisions through the original revision store. Reopen original issued/returned files after complete workspace receiving.
task.completeOutput: Complete source captures and coverage; actual reviewed forms and full inspection/attachment histories; crews, work packages, assignments, effort corrections and follow-ups; immutable supervisor-approved local proposals; full original dataset projection, import reviews, native comparison groups/rows/decisions and reports; complete original and independently received staff/native workspaces; working browser and agent access; source, operating guides, actual acceptance observations and continuing support ownership.
task.repeatTrigger: A source owner supplies a new acquisition, a field team records another observation, a supervisor returns work, a staffing or follow-up decision changes, or a reviewer needs another explicitly selected comparison. Continue existing request/result and publication identities after interruption. A genuinely later source capture receives its own original capture identity while preserving the prior edition and every linked inspection.
task.pricedUnit: The agreed customer implementation workshare or explicitly selected operating service in the original commercial plan. Preserve the existing proposed Geocove USD 16,800 / 120-hour / 20-active-day scope with its allowance of four layers, two related tables and three forms. Those allowances describe the proposal; actual metadata and agreed customer selection determine the datasets. Preserve the original payment schedule and native atomic-unit prices when applicable.

source.reference: Actual authorized ArcGIS service metadata, original ID/count queries, complete feature response bodies, original attachment inventories/bytes, customer field and staffing decisions, approved inspection proposals and unchanged source-native dataset deliveries. The original programme observed the public Livingston County Highways FeatureServer; a customer's selected tenant and production destination retain their own identity.
source.population: Select up to four advertised layers and two advertised tables. Retain complete selected ObjectID sets, initial/final counts and metadata, every returned feature, missing/unexpected/duplicate identities, all attachment observations and unavailable attachment results. Default capture limits are 100,000 features, 10,000 attachments and 256 MiB retained files; individual JSON responses are at most 32 MiB and attachments 64 MiB. Review explicit complete cohort limits before acquisition. Service tables or relationships are selected only when actually advertised.
source.meaning: Retain source field names and native types, ObjectID and actual GlobalID, service/item/dataset identity, subtype and coded/range domains, nullability and editability, geometry type/dimensions/CRS and original attachment identities. Null differs from empty text. Source values, local inspection fields and photos, approved proposed values and actual production outcomes remain separate records. For native comparison, declare every projection column and encoding; use JSON text for complete features, geometry and values that the original CSV numeric types cannot represent exactly.
source.changePolicy: Import later observations as immutable source editions. A refresh never rewrites an earlier capture or approved inspection. Review changed attributes, geometry, schema and attachments, resolve conflicts explicitly, rebase to a new inspection draft and obtain a new supervisor decision. Refresh the original assignment against that actual new inspection. A reused ObjectID with a different GlobalID does not silently retain the old asset identity. All production GIS writes use the customer's separately selected supported integration and its original authority.

receiving.application: The maintained highway-field-operations product in SCF Applications, with the complete original Highway application under products/highway-field-operations/app/. Select workspaceDirectory, pythonExecutable (3.11+), nodeExecutable (22+ for the original dataset producer), private connectionFile, receivingDirectory and loopback port. To use native reconciliation, select both pairedWorkspaceDirectory and its exact existing pairedWorkspaceId, with DuckDB 1.5.6. A received staff branch uses its own Applications entry and, where applicable, its independently restored paired directory/ID. HighwayFieldClient and merchant_highway_ methods operate the same original saved application.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Open the actual installed staff interface at the working display width and at 390 px where relevant. Operate the selected original capture, form, inspection, correction, submission, supervisor, crew and assignment controls. Verify complete actual field and attachment values, source refresh/conflict choices, assignment closure against the current approval and the whole operating report. Produce an approved local proposal, run the original paired import/compare/review/export flow and inspect every required row/group/report page. Export and receive the complete staff and native packages into distinct directories, make a legitimate later edit, reopen it, repeat receiving without losing that edit and retain the following full export. Record actual observations in the original Installation. Open the exact self-contained field HTML in independent browser profiles, retain named editions and incomplete drafts, inspect complete actual source/attachments and reopen downloaded HTML/JSON. Introduce an actual separately retained supervisor correction, review the three-value comparison and explicit choices, adopt through the existing writer, then independently receive the full archive and reopen every original field file with its exact descriptor.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: Retain the actual source-use and attachment permissions, customer service/account ownership, operating-person authority and data retention choices. Keep private connection capabilities and any source token in their designated local configuration. Record withdrawals and retention/deletion changes for the original and received copies through the named owners. An approved local proposal requires a separately implemented, authorized and observed target edit before any production update is recorded.
receiving.recovery: Keep the portable workspace ID and canonical physical branch together. Recover a saved full command envelope and request UUID before sending another mutation. Use the current saved workspace/record version only after preserving the unsent draft and reviewing the actual conflict. Retain original capture requests and response bodies, native request/first result and accepted SF100 page prefix. If a native effect completed before the staff revision advanced, associate its retained original result instead of rerunning it. Reuse the original publication/archive identity and receiving destination, preserve later receiver edits and continue managed Start/Stop through its original Applications operation. Field-copy drafts and requests are scoped to the original physical directory. A competing local draft retains complete device and incoming values for deliberate recovery. Unfinished returned files remain retained but require a real named edition before comparison/adoption.
receiving.maintenance: Name the source/service owner, form designer, field operators, supervisors, crew lead, native reconciliation reviewer, actual production writer when selected, receiving engineer and continuing support owner. Keep cadence and full-cohort selection, schema/domain/form changes, source and workspace backups, attachment retention, private connection renewal, paired warehouse restore and the original commercial correction allowance in the operating handover. Preserve the full source selection, licenses, original dependency versions and complete guides.

steps.title: Continue the original customer and funded workshare
steps.result: Open the existing company case, commercial plan and Customer installation. Preserve every original phase, effort source, funding assignment, payment selection and acceptance condition. A new PLANNED seed is appropriate only for a customer installation that has not already been operated.

steps.title: Select the actual source, cohort and operating owners
steps.result: Record service URL/item, advertised datasets and relationships, exact full population, source/attachment permissions, actual forms and staffing, selected physical workspaces and accountable reviewers. Check current service capabilities from its own metadata.

steps.title: Install and open the complete maintained product
steps.result: Receive the selected full release and original dependencies. Review and save the Highway application in Applications, start its original managed owner and open the staff interface. Confirm the actual workspace identity, physical branch, current revision and optional paired warehouse.

steps.title: Capture and import the whole selected source
steps.result: Keep one original capture operation and directory. Retain all metadata, ID/count inventories, feature/attachment requests and complete bodies. Review completeness and source-change observations, then import the full manifest and every declared file into the original staff workspace.

steps.title: Design forms from source types and actual field needs
steps.result: Choose exact source fields and subtype/domain behavior, explicit local observations, read-only identity fields, geometry policy and attachment limits. Save the complete form edition. Preserve earlier form versions and their existing inspection bindings.

steps.title: Operate field inspection and supervisor review
steps.result: Open an actual captured asset, save complete typed answers, original geometry and added attachments, submit the saved edition and record the supervisor's approve/return/reject decision. A correction retains the original submission/reason and creates a new draft for review.

steps.title: Exchange named field copies and review returned work
steps.result: Select actual saved inspections and named recipient/instructions; issue complete original source/form/history/attachment JSON and self-contained editable HTML. Operate the colleague's independent working copy, save attributed named editions and retain unfinished drafts. Receive the full original return without applying it, review every issued/current/returned field conflict and current assignment, explicitly keep or adopt each inspection through the original command/CAS, then continue normal submission and supervisor approval. Reopen both issued formats and exact returned file after independent whole-workspace receiving.

steps.title: Dispatch crews and record real follow-through
steps.result: Create actual crews, packages and assignments linked to the original source/form/asset. Record transitions, whole-minute actual effort and reasoned voids, named follow-ups and outcomes. Close an assignment only against its current approved inspection and resolved follow-through.

steps.title: Refresh the source and continue the same field work
steps.result: Acquire and import a distinct later source edition. Review all changed fields, geometry, schema and attachments; choose each mapped conflict deliberately; rebase to a new draft and obtain its current approval. Refresh the original assignment from that exact inspection, preserving source lineage and all earlier closures.

steps.title: Prepare the complete approved candidate and operating report
steps.result: Combine current approved inspections into the retained local proposal. Resolve incompatible values and attachment identities. Freeze the full crew/package/assignment/effort/follow-up report and retain both complete JSON and readable output with the original workspace.

steps.title: Run original paired reconciliation and reviewed native reporting
steps.result: Materialize the exact selected captured/proposed rows and declared column map, then use the original CSV handler and SF100 page/finalize/scan APIs. Review/import both actual editions; review and save the pair at its current revision; run, inspect full groups/rows and record decisions; freeze and export the original native report.

steps.title: Independently receive staff and native workspaces
steps.result: Retain the complete staff archive and every native report/package member. Receive the staff history and selected source into a distinct physical directory and restore the original native warehouse using its actual receive_package API. Continue later edits on that branch, reopen it and retain its complete following export.

steps.title: Record customer receiving and continuing support
steps.result: Attach the complete original and independent receiving outputs to the existing Installation. Record actual visible and programmatic observations, the accountable customer decision, retained production integration selection, remaining ordinary operating decisions and the agreed correction/support procedure. Export and reopen the complete original SCF case.

inputs: Original customer case, complete commercial plan, phase/effort/funding assignments, proposed Geocove scope and actual current Installation.
Actual selected service/item, advertised layer/table IDs, relationships, source field/geometry/attachment metadata and full authorized cohort boundaries.
Complete original source captures with original operation/request UUIDs, manifest hash, every declared byte file, initial/final inventories and coverage/change observations.
Actual form fields, original types/domains/subtypes, local observation needs, geometry permissions, attachment policy and full form lineage.
Named field operators and supervisors, complete original answers/geometry/photos, submissions, correction reasons and actual decisions.
Crews/members, work packages, source-bound assignments, actual whole-minute effort, void reasons, named follow-ups, due times and closure basis.
Later independent capture, complete field/schema/geometry/attachment comparison, conflict choices, rebased inspection and refreshed assignment identity.
Current approved proposal IDs/digests, original source binding, all proposed attribute/geometry/attachment changes and complete operating reports.
Explicit native fieldMap/encoding, original JSONL/CSV/projection files, SF30 schema/limits, all real pages/cursors/intents, SF100 completed scan and original engine import reviews.
Original paired warehouse, selected source/target editions, full pair definition and revision, actual run/decision/report IDs, complete pages and original exported native package.

Canonical original and independent staff directories; pairedWorkspaceDirectory and exact original pairedWorkspaceId together when selected; actual Python 3.11+, DuckDB 1.5.6 and Node 22+; complete selected source and original licenses.
Original saved command/publication/receiving identities, private connection selection, receiving engineer, actual later edit/reopen observations and following complete archive.
Actual customer-controlled production edit integration, capability snapshot, target mapping, authorization and per-record native outcomes only when that scope is selected.
Source cadence, backup/restore and retention ownership, ongoing support procedure and original payment/service-price selections.

Actual field-issue recipient/instructions and inspection IDs, complete original issue JSON/HTML, every returned named edition and unfinished draft, added attachment bytes, explicit baseline/current/return decisions, and original command IDs/revisions for issue/receive/adopt.
